summary: Team Faz 2 + Task Jump UX enhancement verified via full end-to-end frontend testing. Created overdue task for emp1_test (due_date=2026-01-01), triggered scan-now, then verified all task-jump behaviors as mgr_test and emp1_test. All acceptance criteria pass: (a) popover closes on notification click, (b) notification marked read (badge 1→0), (c) Sidebar auto-switches to Görevler tab (border-sertex-cyan + text-sertex-cyan neon-glow active class applied on data-testid=tab-tasks), (d) target task card gains ring-2 + animate-pulse + shadow classes, (e) highlight auto-clears after ~4s. Race-condition fix (window.__sertex_pending_task_jump) works from a fresh login where Görevler tab was NOT previously active. Cross-user (emp1_test) also works and correctly hides tab-team. tab-team still visible for mgr_test (Faz 2 regression OK).
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx line ~1362: window.__sertex_pending_task_jump global namespace is unusual but acceptable given the mount-order race. Consider moving to a React context/zustand store to avoid polluting window (low priority).

NotificationBell.jsx clickItem(): if n.task_id is falsy, popover is NOT closed (setOpen(false) is inside the if-block). Minor UX inconsistency — non-task notifications keep popover open after being marked read.
TasksPanel.jsx line 1357: setTimeout(4000) auto-clear uses a functional updater guard (cur === tid) — good defensive pattern, prevents stale-timeout wiping a newer highlight.
